name: 70454 · Ponchatoula, LA
findings: ZIP 70454 (Ponchatoula) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70454 (Ponchatoula) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70454 (Ponchatoula) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 33% of the typical level).
